acceptance_criteria.criterion: A trusted issuer edge can be started/deployed from trusted repository-owned code/config.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: scripts/hunter_issue_agent_issuer.py vends IssuerServer as repository-owned code: configuration is derived from repository-owned environment defaults through IssuerConfiguration.from_environment and the merged compose_services composition root, and the suite starts the real server on ephemeral ports. .github/workflows/hunter-issue-agent-issuer-deploy.yml ships the trusted deploy path, and test_healthz_is_ok, test_authorized_issue_runs_the_governed_path_over_http and test_missing_operational_configuration_fails_closed exercise start, readiness and the fail-closed configuration surface.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The GitHub trigger can reach it using the documented secret-backed webhook URL.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: docs/ISSUE_AGENT_ISSUER_DEPLOYMENT.md documents the two secret-backed values (HUNTER_ISSUE_AGENT_WEBHOOK_URL and the issuer authorization signing key) and the deploy workflow is committed, but live provisioning of those secrets and GitHub-trigger reachability of a deployed edge cannot be demonstrated from committed content in this slice. The operational proof is outstanding and Issue #423 remains open, so this criterion cannot be adjudged from the candidate itself.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: One authorized Issue event passes end-to-end through authorization -> SmartPromptMachine build -> persistence -> signed handoff -> fallback runtime boundary.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: test_authorized_issue_runs_the_governed_path_over_http drives one explicitly authorized synthetic Issue event over HTTP end-to-end: issauth/v1 signature and identity verified, the merged SmartPromptMachine build produced, the canonical build persisted to the evidence database before the signed PromptAutomationEnvelopeHandoff is issued, and the unchanged envelope forwarded to the fallback runtime whose success rule is remote HEAD advance plus targeted validation (test_provider_text_is_never_receipt_of_success, test_the_exact_handoff_is_passed_unchanged_to_the_runtime).

Fail-closed transport matrix, each branch pinned by the focused suite: unknown path 404 (test_unknown_paths_fail_closed); missing Content-Length 411 (test_missing_content_length_is_refused); invalid/incomplete Content-Length 400 (test_invalid_content_length_is_refused); oversized payload 413 refused before any body read (test_oversized_content_length_is_refused_before_reading); withheld body 408 under the bounded read deadline (test_a_stalled_body_does_not_block_healthz_or_other_requests, test_a_stalled_body_is_terminated_within_the_read_deadline); malformed/duplicate-key/unsigned envelope 400 (test_malformed_bodies_fail_closed, test_duplicate_json_keys_fail_closed, test_bare_unsigned_payload_is_not_executable); forged/lifted signature and foreign signer 401 (test_a_foreign_signer_is_refused_before_execution, test_a_signature_lifted_from_another_authorization_is_refused); foreign repository 403 after signature verification (test_foreign_repository_is_refused_after_verification); replay 409 with exactly one execution (test_duplicate_authorization_is_rejected_and_executes_once, test_replay_after_process_restart_does_not_execute_again); missing Source Handling authority and denied retention 422; configuration and persistence failure 500 (test_an_unexpected_runtime_failure_is_reported_as_fail_closed_500).

acceptance_criteria.criterion: No secret value is stored in repository content.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Repository content carries only environment-variable names, never secret values: provisioning documentation names HUNTER_ISSUE_AGENT_WEBHOOK_URL and the signing-key variable; the verifying key is captured from os.environ at bootstrap, never a committed value (test_issuer_verifying_key_is_captured_at_bootstrap_not_reead); the deterministic harness fabricates keys at runtime from machine env seeds; and test_issuer_edge_reuses_existing_authorities_only asserts the transport source holds no private-key material (.sign( and Ed25519PrivateKey absent), with the repository secret-scan guard enforced at the push boundary.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Focused tests, exact-head hosted validation, Governance Review, independent review, and Merge Readiness are green.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: These gates are current GitHub state adjudicated on the exact head after Ready election, not properties provable from committed content. This review is the pre-ready attestation that binds the d46af60..HEAD blob-exact target the hosted lane receives; the push boundary already enforces exact-head hosted validation (hunter_pr_preflight.py --mode normal) and the deterministic guards. A green status for the external controllers therefore cannot be minted here and is not claimed.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Issue #390 can be closed only after this operational proof exists.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Nothing in the candidate closes Issue #390 or declares the operational proof complete: the close condition is preserved, the E2E coverage remains synthetic (explicitly authorized test-issued event, not a live production webhook event), and the outstanding live proof is recorded as finding F-4 with Issue #423 deliberately left open.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The edge must reuse the merged production SmartPromptMachine composition root and consume hunter-issue-agent-authorization-v1 exactly; there must be no second prompt/build path.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: The transport's only downstream authority is the signed hunter-issue-agent-authorization-v1 envelope parsed by SignedIssueAgentAuthorization.from_json, and execution runs through the merged compose_services root from hunter.automation.issue_agent_execution; test_issuer_edge_reuses_existing_authorities_only pins that the edge composes existing authorities only and that the source contains no signing capability or parallel transport (no Ed25519PrivateKey, no .sign().

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The canonical Smart Prompt build must be persisted before the signed automation handoff is issued.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: execute_authorization persists the canonical build and authorization receipt into the evidence database inside the handler boundary before the signed PromptAutomationEnvelopeHandoff is produced and forwarded; test_crash_between_handoff_persistence_and_dispatch_cannot_duplicate, test_duplicate_authorization_is_rejected_and_executes_once and test_replay_after_process_restart_does_not_execute_again pin persist-before-forward and duplicate-free execution.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The signed PromptAutomationEnvelopeHandoff and provider text must pass unchanged into the existing fallback runtime; provider text alone is never success.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: test_the_exact_handoff_is_passed_unchanged_to_the_runtime requires the runtime to receive the byte-exact signed envelope with issue text unchanged; test_no_issue_text_reaches_the_fallback_runtime and test_provider_text_is_never_receipt_of_success pin that raw text is not honoured and that success requires remote HEAD advance plus targeted validation.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: No issue text, webhook caller, or request body controls provider ordering, route/profile selection, Source Handling, context policy, retention, or evidence authority.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Downstream decisions derive from IssuerConfiguration and the merged profile/route registries (the engineering-review profile and the issue-agent route registry), never from body content; test_no_issue_text_reaches_the_fallback_runtime, test_missing_source_handling_authority_fails_closed_422, test_denied_retention_fails_closed_422 and test_missing_operational_configuration_fails_closed pin that missing or caller-contradicted authority fails closed.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The transport must have an explicit, small concurrency bound and a finite request read deadline so one unauthenticated client cannot starve the edge or hold a worker indefinitely.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: _BoundedThreadingHTTPServer (ThreadingMixIn with a Semaphore worker cap, default 8) rejects a saturated socket with a deterministic 503 and daemon threads keep shutdown deterministic; every request runs under Handler.timeout (default 15s), so a declared-but-withheld body is failed closed with 408 within a bounded time. test_the_worker_bound_is_enforced_with_a_deterministic_503, test_a_stalled_body_does_not_block_healthz_or_other_requests and test_a_stalled_body_is_terminated_within_the_read_deadline regression-pin all three under the real server.

defect_families.evidence: No authorization can be re-aimed: the edge binds the issuer-signature proof to the exact authorization claims (test_the_issuer_proof_covers_every_authorization_claim), a signature lifted from another authorization is refused (test_a_signature_lifted_from_another_authorization_is_refused), and a foreign repository is refused after verification (test_foreign_repository_is_refused_after_verification).

No forgery surface is introduced: the transport parses only the canonical signed envelope and proves the exact-handoff bytes unchanged into the runtime (test_the_exact_handoff_is_passed_unchanged_to_the_runtime); internal failure detail is never sent to callers and the stall tests assert no Traceback or internal wording in the 408 response.

Admission stays satisfiable: an explicitly authorized synthetic event executes exactly once through the governed path (test_authorized_issue_runs_the_governed_path_over_http) while unsatisfiable or foreign events fail closed at the transport (404/411/400/413/408/401/403/409/422/500 matrix), and a saturated transport fails closed with a deterministic 503 instead of queueing behind an unbounded backlog.

Writer provenance and the connector push boundary are untouched by this range; both authored commits on the range carry verified SSH writer signatures and were committed through the repository-local pre-push hook, which re-validates provenance over the governed range before authorizing the network push.

No evidence is stranded: this review binds the d46af60..HEAD blob-exact target (the review artifact itself excluded), and the prior commits forwarded their proof to the same exact-head identity rather than a run identity or moment.

No connector authorization receipt is published or reused by this range; the connector receipt path stays excluded from reviewed targets for the canonical reason and receipt-freshness semantics are not loosened.

The pre-ready hostile review is the subject here: the review is recorded against the exact d46af60..HEAD content, covers all ten applicable families, all seven acceptance criteria Issue #423 defines, and the six additional swept statements, and carries no unresolved blocking finding.
No transient run state is published as a defect: the review is content-bound (blob SHAs and a target digest), not run-bound, and names no live gate result as proof of anything.

No guard is relabelled: the candidate's tests regression-pin behaviour end-to-end under the real server, and nothing in this range edits the defect catalog, its validator, or the prevention lifecycle document.

The validation reuse authority is untouched: this candidate carries its own server suite validated at the exact head by the push boundary, and nothing in the range modifies the validation stage contract or re-aims a proof made for another candidate.

findings.evidence: Single-worker body-starvation denial-of-service in the issuer edge: a client declares a body and withholds it, occupying the only request thread and stalling /healthz and authorized requests. Found in this adversarial pass and corrected in-commit by a bounded concurrent server (explicit default 8-worker cap, deterministic 503 on saturation, daemon threads) and a finite per-connection read deadline that fails the withheld body with a deterministic 408. The three stall regressions pin the fix under the real server.

Transport failure responses could in principle expose internal framing details to unauthenticated callers. Resolved by generic flat error bodies with no internal state or traceback (the stall tests assert no Traceback or internal wording), keeping the failure surface opaque.

Worker-slot accounting across abrupt thread exit. Resolved by releasing the Semaphore in process_request_thread finally and on the accept path when thread spawn fails, so the explicit worker bound is exact and a slot can never be leaked; the bounded read deadline caps any dwell.

Live operational proof pending: the documented secrets (HUNTER_ISSUE_AGENT_WEBHOOK_URL and the issuer authorization signing key) are not yet provisioned in production and a deployed trusted edge reached by the GitHub trigger has not been proven end-to-end. This candidate is an implementation slice, not the closing change, so Issue #423 remains open and nothing in the range closes Issue #390.
